title: Connecticut ARML
text:
Qualification for the Connecticut ARML Team is via the Connecticut ARML Qualification Test. The team takes part in the ARML at the Penn State location.

In 2024, the ARML Qualification Test will be given online on March 7th. Registration for the test will close on February 29th. For those who qualify for the team there will be two practices and two team selection tests. All four of these events will be held on Saturday mornings, online.

For further information about the CT ARML Team and to register for the test please see the team’s webpage or contact CTARMLTeam@gmail.com.
